planets.name: TOI-6324 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-6324 with a 0.279-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-6324 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-6324. Its orbit and size follow Lee et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
